Install omarchy-themes-intros on Omarchy

Background intro videos for the Omarchy themes

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omarchy-themes-intros
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 2026.10.14-1:
    pacman -Qi omarchy-themes-intros

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omarchy-themes-intros on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-themes-intros. The download is 96.3 MB and it takes 96.4 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omarchy-themes-intros free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall omarchy-themes-intros?

Run omarchy pkg drop omarchy-themes-intros. It removes the package from your system.

What does omarchy-themes-intros depend on?

omarchy-themes-intros declares no dependencies in the Omarchy package database.

Is omarchy-themes-intros in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omarchy-themes-intros (version 2026.10.14-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. 37signals makes it. Project site: https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy.
